text:
I’m passionate about building reliable products and I’m the kind of hard-working full-stack developer who likes stepping in wherever a team needs support.

With 7 years of experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, I’d be a strong fit for the kind of flexible, independent help you’re looking for. Your need for someone who can jump in on random tasks across React, Node, SaaS, WordPress, and modules is exactly the kind of environment I’m comfortable in, especially when a project is evolving and the team needs someone who can adapt quickly.

One project that reflects this is Embedded customer analytics for a B2B SaaS product. I built usage dashboards embedded inside the product so each customer account could see its own metrics. The work was rolled out to 140 customer accounts and delivered 3 weeks early. That kind of build required thoughtful full-stack work, clear implementation, and keeping the experience reliable for end users.

I can help your company by supporting your existing developers on feature work, UI implementation, API work, and general product development. I’m comfortable working across the stack and taking ownership of tasks without needing a lot of hand-holding. If you need someone who can contribute consistently, communicate clearly, and fit into a long-term working relationship, I’d be glad to help.

I also understand the value of availability during USA hours, and I can align well with a schedule that overlaps with 9 am PST to 7 pm PST. That makes it easier to stay responsive when tasks come up and to work smoothly with your team.

If we work together, I’d aim to make your other developers’ lives easier by handling work cleanly and dependably, while staying flexible as your systems grow.

What are the first few tasks you’d want help with most right now?
